title: Audit SHOP-260: show an out-of-stock badge

issue.summary: Show an out-of-stock badge on the product card
issue.description:
Show an "Out of stock" badge on ProductCard when product.stock is 0, using the existing Badge component with the muted variant.

Acceptance criteria:
- When stock is 0, the card shows an "Out of stock" badge.
- When stock is above 0, no badge is shown.
- The Add to cart button is disabled when stock is 0.

verifiedFacts: ProductCard shows no stock badge today
The Product type has a stock field
The Add to cart button is always enabled today
mustStayUncertain: Whether products with low but non-zero stock need their own badge
forbiddenClaims: A low-stock badge or threshold as a requirement
The ticket's acceptance criteria reported as missing or not testable
A conflict with the code, when the code matches what the ticket describes
